    51	# Stage 2: bounded nesting pre-scan of the decoded text.

    54	def scan_depth(text):
    55	    """Return True unless bracket nesting exceeds the wire limit.
    56	
    57	    Double-quoted strings and backslash escapes are honoured exactly as JSON
    58	    does; delimiter kinds are not matched.  Depth never drops below zero.
    59	    """
    60	    depth = 0
    61	    instr = False
    62	    esc = False
    63	    for ch in text:
    64	        if instr:
    65	            if esc:
    66	                esc = False
    67	            elif ch == '\\':
    68	                esc = True
    69	            elif ch == '"':
    70	                instr = False
    71	        elif ch == '"':
    72	            instr = True
    73	        elif ch == '{' or ch == '[':
    74	            depth += 1
    75	            if depth > NEST_LIMIT:
    76	                return False
    77	        elif ch == '}' or ch == ']':
    78	            if depth:
    79	                depth -= 1
    80	    return True

   100	def _parse_int(text):

   117	def scan_values(root):
   118	    """Every string and object key must hold valid Unicode scalar values."""
   119	    bad_str = False
   120	    stack = [root]
   121	    while stack:
   122	        node = stack.pop()
   123	        kind = type(node)
   124	        if kind is str:
